home.heroSubtitle: Discover verified breeders, follow their litters, inspect a dog's pedigree, and reserve safely with a deposit — then, when it's time, arrange trusted transport from pickup to handover.
home.forBreedersBannerDesc: One page for your kennel — litters, dogs, history and followers — that you can link from Facebook, Instagram or your own site.
home.followJourneyTitle: A breeder's whole story, not just a listing
home.followJourneyDesc: Every kennel gets a permanent public profile — planned litters, current puppies, and every puppy they've ever placed, kept as history instead of disappearing once sold. Follow a kennel to hear about their next litter before it's even born.
home.pedigreesTitle: A dog's family tree, traceable and attributed
home.pedigreesDesc: Every claim about a dog's ancestry carries its own source and verification level — breeder-entered, document-supported, or registry-verified — never one unattributed "verified" badge.

footer.tagline: A dedicated European animal ecosystem — verified breeders, foundation adoptions and a trusted community, with safe transport available every step of the way.
footer.welfareDisclaimer: Anemalo does not guarantee the health or behaviour of any animal, nor a fixed transport delivery time before review.
